diagnostics.message: The launch template references the runner instance profile by its locally computed name, so Terraform does not order its creation after the profile; the instance profile must exist for instances launched from this template to assume the role.

The launch template uses the locally computed role name when selecting its instance profile, which does not create an ordering edge to the IAM role. The role should exist before the EC2 instance is launched with that profile.

The instance profile names the IAM role via a local value rather than referencing the role resource. The profile must be created only after the role exists; otherwise AWS can reject profile creation because the named role is absent.
